beats.superText: Be rewarded like never before with CommBank Yello.

beats.vo: As you may have heard, we've introduced changes across CommBank Yello and some of our credit card products, as we evolve how customers are recognised and rewarded for their banking relationship.
beats.superText: Evolving how customers are recognised and rewarded.

beats.vo: To recap these core changes: from 1 October, we'll be introducing CommBank Yello points, unlocking a whole new world of points and perks for our customers. Customers will have more ways to earn and use rewards across their everyday banking, travel, shopping and participating brand programs.

Following the closure of the CommBank Awards program on 29 September, eligible credit card customers will transition to earning CommBank Yello points from 1 October, based on their CommBank Yello tier.
In addition to this, we are excited to announce more ways in which we are rewarding our customers for their eligible banking and giving them choice in how they are rewarded.
beats.superText: More ways to be rewarded — and more choice.

beats.vo: For CommBank customers, finding the best place for travel has never been easier. Travel Booking lets customers search and book flights, hotels and car rentals in the CommBank app.
beats.superText: Finding the best place for travel has never been easier.

beats.vo: It also gives customers access to CommBank exclusive travel offers on flights, hotels and car hire, as well as 24/7 support.

So, from 1 October, customers can use and earn CommBank Yello points with Travel Booking. This means they can earn 5x points per $1 spent on hotel and car rental bookings, and 2x points for every $1 spent on flight bookings.
beats.superText: Use and earn Yello points with Travel Booking.

beats.vo: Also, with Dine in Deals, customers can discover and redeem exclusive offers at participating restaurants across Australia.
beats.superText: Discover and redeem exclusive offers with Dine in Deals.

beats.vo: From 1 October, eligible credit card customers will receive a monthly $10 Dining Credit for Dine in Deals provided by EatClub, while CommBank Yello customers can earn up to 5 CommBank Yello points per $1 spent on eligible dining purchases, making every meal even more rewarding.
As part of this exciting change, the way customers earn points on their CommBank credit card and broader everyday banking activity will change too.
beats.superText: How you earn points is changing too.

beats.vo: From 1 October, customers will have more ways to earn and use Yello points across daily essentials, shopping and travel, plus access to a wide range of redemption partners.
beats.superText: More ways to earn and use Yello points.

beats.vo: Depending on their tier and eligible credit card type, customers can earn up to 1.5 Yello points on every $1 spent.
And regardless of their tier, they'll earn 2x the Yello points for every dollar spent on international transactions.
These are some ways we are rewarding Australians with points and perks for the banking they do every day.
beats.superText: Points and perks for the banking you do every day.

beats.vo: To find out more, visit commbank.com.au/commbankyello or search CommBank Yello on One.CBA.
